title: Document standard (standards/<name>.yaml)
description: One document type's outline and rules, as data: the single source for its sections, the rules `scripts/check_doc.py` checks, and the judgment lines a Reviewer scores. A mode applies it with `standard: {ref, output}`; `task show` prints the outline.

line.description: One sentence (pmos lint: at most lint.budgets.standard_line words, no filler)

sections.description: In document order. A section is the first heading that contains its title or an alias (any case); it runs to the next heading of the same or a higher level.

aliases.description: Other headings accepted for this section

contains.description: What the section holds, shown to the Worker

numbered.description: Items in the section are numbered <prefix>1, <prefix>2, …; contiguous: no gaps

fields.description: A table in the section has a column naming each field

min_items.description: At least this many list items or table rows

forbid.description: Patterns that may not appear anywhere in the document

judgment.description: Rules code can't check; each becomes a must line (standard-1, …) the Reviewer judges
